reports.title: DraftKings Reports Third Quarter Revenue Growth of 16%

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2026 Guidance
section: •DraftKings is updating its fiscal year 2026 revenue guidance range to $6.35 billion to $6.55 billion and its fiscal year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $175 million to $275 million, primarily reflecting the Company’s increased Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $650 million to $700 million. The Company expects fiscal year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA from the core business of $875 million to $925 million, which reflects its decision to invest further in iGaming growth as well as the impact of modestly customer-friendly sport outcomes. Predictions revenue will be immaterial in fiscal year 2026, as new customer promotions will offset the lion’s share of gross revenue generated. The Company expects Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $175 million to $225 million in the fourth quarter.

•DraftKings is introducing a fiscal year 2027 revenue guidance range of $7.35 billion to $7.75 billion and a fiscal year 2027 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range of $800 million to $1.0 billion. The Company expects fiscal year 2027 revenue from the core business of $6.7 billion to $7.0 billion, an increase of 4% to 9% year-over-year compared to the midpoint of fiscal year 2026 guidance, and Adjusted EBITDA from the core business of $1.15 billion to $1.25 billion. The Company expects fiscal year 2027 Predictions revenue of $650 million to $750 million and Adjusted EBITDA investment in Predictions of $250 million to $350 million.
